title: FC 5302: Definitions
officialText:
5302.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

COMPRESSED GAS.

Nonliquefied compressed gases.

Liquefied compressed gases.

Compressed gases in solution.

Compressed gas mixtures.

COMPRESSED GAS CONTAINER.

COMPRESSED GAS SYSTEM.

HYPERBARIC FACILITY.

NESTING.

TUBE TRAILER.
